book.title: The Distracted Mind
book.author: Adam Gazzaley and Larry D. Rosen

predict.question: You have thirty minutes and work in three-minute chunks, but every chunk also costs seven minutes of switching. How many minutes of actual task work do you complete?

exploreHint: Compare both named cases; keep each result for the reveal.
bookIdea: The Distracted Mind discusses interference and the costs of switching between goals.
modelBoundary: Short switches allow {A}; longer switches {B}. The larger overhead leaves room for fewer complete task chunks.
doesItHoldUp: Does it hold up? Actual switching costs vary; neither invented time is a measured human effect.
